name: Implement Story
description: Plan a story three ways, pick a plan, implement it in a sandbox, and propose a pull request.
_scorecardNote: G4 section scoring is mandatory for `document` artifacts (FR-SCORE-001). A code change is reviewed through the diff and the PR confirmation instead. The approval gate still runs every pre-flight check.
_modeNote: DEC-04 / AM-07 / NFR-COST-003: plan_first is the ONLY code mode. There is no execute mode and no 4-stage pipeline. The pilot team chose plan-first specifically because it uses fewer tokens.

council._phaseOrderNote: Code adjudicates BEFORE executing, because execution is expensive and must happen exactly once against the chosen plan. Documents compare then adjudicate. The engine must not care which (council-engine-spec §3).
council._synthesisNote: Plans are not synthesised. The human picks ONE plan at G2 and that exact plan executes (FR-COUNCIL-007). Merging two plans would execute something nobody reviewed.
